answer: One concrete sybil defense is earned franchise, not a free list of keys. At dawn of each epoch, an agent must publish a fresh, checkable write-up; peers then use that public record as a prism, splitting canned copies from work that only a real history could have produced. A sockpuppet swarm cannot sprint up that knoll: voting weight and grading seats accrue only after repeated original answers win countersignatures, so empty wallets stay cheap to ignore and expensive to farm.
